chapter: Pedal points, Hampton, Norvo and Debut
title: Playing with Red Norvo and Tal Farlow
summary: Johnson recalls Mingus dominating the trio; Mingus on Norvo's stiff beat and music he wrote for the group.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
